sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 25** across American network, Bing Crosby & Rosemary Clooney's breezy morning vocal duets, two eras of domestic comedy on *Father Knows Best* starring Robert Young (Maxwell House & Post Bran Flakes), Sir Ralph Richardson in Arnold Bennett's *The Judgement*, outback aviation on *The Flying Doctor*, and Broadway belter Ethel Merman on *The Royal Gelatin Hour* (1938–1961):
